## Summary
Implements **P07.1 — the layered document-parsing stack** (`docs/tickets/P07.1__parsing-stack.md`, canonical spec §24): the parser interface **every connector extracts through**. P07.2/P07.3 and every later document connector extract *through* this stack, so the layer enum, locator schema, `raw_value` contract, and versioned reason-code mapping are a stable interface.

Added to the `parsing` package beside the P05.2 §25 model boundary (which is layer 6 of the stack). **No new third-party dependency** (`pylock.toml` unchanged) and **no DDL** — it produces the shapes the P02 claim spine already stores (`claim.raw_value`, `claim.normalization_*`, `claim_evidence.locator`, `extraction.method`).

## What changed
- `parsing/layers.py` — the seven extraction layers as a cost-ordered `IntEnum` + `cheapest_sufficient`; each layer's `.method` is the recorded `extraction.method` (`llm_assisted` matches the DB CHECK tying layer 6 to §25) — **SIG-PARSE-001**
- `parsing/classification.py` — `classify` / `classify_archive`: classification before parsing by magic-byte + stdlib-`zipfile` manifest signals, mixed-format archives classified **per member** (scanned fax, `/Encrypt` PDF, merged-header XLSX, multi-sheet export) — **SIG-PARSE-002**
- `parsing/locator.py` — the six-kind `Locator` schema (page/bbox/cell/row/byte-range/DOM path), validated — **SIG-PARSE-003**
- `parsing/claim.py` — `ParsedValue`/`ParsedClaim`: `raw_value` preserved before typing **including for unparseable values**; a locator-less claim is **rejected** — **SIG-PARSE-004 / 003**
- `parsing/reason_codes.py` + `data/reason_codes.toml` — a **versioned, inspectable, reversible** reason mapping; version stamped on the claim; free-text vs constrained-dropdown distinguished; changed by migration, never a history rewrite — **SIG-PARSE-005/006, SIG-STORE-038**
- `parsing/drift.py` — committed **fixtures** that fail a test on parser drift, and a structural **canary** that *alerts* (never drops) on live drift — **SIG-PARSE-007/008 (R11)**
- `sig-parsing classify|layers|reason` CLI; a committed mixed-format records-response fixture; **ADR-033**; traceability + risk-register (Phase 7, R11) updates

## Design decisions (ADR-033)
- Classification routes by byte/zip-manifest signals with **no `pypdf`/`openpyxl`**; the heavy layer-3/4/5 engines are deferred to the P07.2/P07.3 connectors that extract through this interface (symmetric with how `parsing.extraction` injects a `ModelClient`).
- Reason codes are versioned **data**, changed by `vocabulary_migration` new claims, never a rewrite (SIG-STORE-038).
- Reason-kind/signal fields map onto existing claim-spine columns rather than a new migration.
